note: Ecuador: nationals of the countries listed need a visa, applied for online as an e-Visa (China's exemption ended on 1 July 2024); everyone else enters without a visa for 90 days (Andean and Mercosur citizens on an identity card). Venezuelans' special visas aren't modelled. Read from Wikipedia's copy of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' list. Checked on 2026-11-03 against the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Human Mobility's own list of the countries that must present a visa: it names Kyrgyzstan, which Wikipedia's copy, read before, had left visa-free, so Kyrgyzstan was moved to the visa; it doesn't name Macao or Taiwan, whose passports were moved to the 90 days without a visa. The list doesn't give the 90 days, or say the visa is applied for online: those stand on Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores y Movilidad Humana del Ecuador, Lista de países que deben presentar visa al ingresar al Ecuador
